{{Youmay|the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] group|[[Pammich Nerro Goode]]}}
'''''Goode''''' was a group of four [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]]s used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The [[Transport/Legends|transports]] attempted to defend a Rebel foothold consisting of four [[Class-C cargo container]]s ''[[Berm]]'', a single [[Class-B cargo container]] ''[[Clip]]'' and a [[Utility Tug/Legends|Utility Tug]] ''[[T-DP]]'', while two [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class shuttle]] groups, ''[[Trail]]'' and ''[[Guild]]'', attacked oncoming [[TIE series/Legends|Imperial starfighters]]. However, the transports, along with the accompanying Rebel [[Starship/Legends|ships]], were destroyed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] in a [[Realspace/Legends|space]]-battle. The conflict was recorded for the [[combat chamber]] to train [[Cadet/Legends|future]] [[TIE pilot]]s, such as [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
